Class SecondFactorService

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.service.SecondFactorService
@Service public class SecondFactorService extends Object
The authenticator-app second factor (TOTP) with its recovery codes: the check that the password sign-in runs before it completes, and the proofs and steps of enrolling, renewing and disabling it. Writes go through CredentialChangeService; wrong proofs count toward the per-user lock of ProofAttemptService.

A code is spent by one conditional statement, so of two overlapping requests with the same code only one succeeds, and a spent code stays spent when the request is refused afterwards for another reason.

    • checkAtSignIn

      public SecondFactorService.SignInCheck checkAtSignIn(User user, String code)
      Checks the second factor of a password sign-in. Called after the password was verified and before the sign-in completes; until it passes, no token is issued.
      Parameters:
      user - the user whose password was verified
      code - the code of the request, may be absent

    • requireProofForNewMethod

      public void requireProofForNewMethod(Integer idUser, String password, String code)
      The proof for adding a sign-in method: the password and, while an authenticator app is enabled, a TOTP or recovery code. Wrong passwords and codes count toward the per-user lock.
      Parameters:
      idUser - the signed-in user
      password - the password of the user
      code - a TOTP or recovery code, needed while a factor is enabled

    • startSetup

      public SecondFactorService.TotpSetup startSetup(Integer idUser, String password, String code)
      Starts a setup or replaces an earlier one that was not confirmed. An enabled factor stays in force until the new secret is confirmed.
      Parameters:
      idUser - the signed-in user
      password - the password of the user
      code - a TOTP or recovery code, needed while a factor is enabled

    • enable

      public CredentialChangeService.RecoveryCodesChange enable(Integer idUser, String code)
      Confirms a setup with a code of the new secret and enables it. The recovery codes are replaced.
      Parameters:
      idUser - the signed-in user
      code - six digits computed from the pending secret
      Returns:
      the new recovery codes and the authentication version for the replacement token
